# KARI 唤醒测试录音

**语言 / Language:** [简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

中英文正样本于 2026-10-28 使用本机 macOS 系统语音合成生成，内容分别为“你好卡里”和“Hey kah ree”，16 kHz 单声道 PCM。前后补静音用于流式识别。负样本为原有普通语句，仅用于误唤醒回归；这些合成样本不代表真实用户或环境噪声验收。

## English

Chinese and English positive samples were generated on 2026-10-28 with local macOS system speech. They say “你好卡里” and “Hey kah ree”, using 16 kHz mono PCM with leading/trailing silence for streaming recognition. Negative fixtures are existing ordinary sentences used for false-trigger regression. These synthetic samples do not constitute human-speaker or environmental-noise acceptance.
